mapper.select: SELECT o.id,o.order_no, o.user_id, u.nickname AS userNickname, o.status, o.total_amount, o.pay_amount, o.pay_time, o.ship_time, o.receive_time, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.receiver_addr, o.create_time FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT id, order_id, order_no, product_id, product_name, product_price, quantity, refund_deadline FROM t_order_item WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY id
